newsitem.title: UK: Sakura Bank unit prices $1.0 bln debt issue.
newsitem.headline: Sakura Bank unit prices $1.0 bln debt issue.

text.p: Sakura Capital Funding Ltd, guaranteed by Sakura Bank, has priced its $1.0 billion two-tranche subordinated perpetual debt issue, sole lead manager Merrill Lynch said on Thursday.
